text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
We're entering the homestretch! In the
lead by five to six lengths is
Silence
Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The rest of the racers are shifting into high
gear in pursuit! Can
Silence Suzuka outrun
them? They're closing in by the second!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
But Silence Suzuka puts the pedal to the
metal and speeds off,
leaving the others
behind!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka! It's Silence Suzuka! She
crosses the finish line and
claims victoryyy!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Another great race for Silence Suzuka and
her runaway style! She's
answered all of
our sincerest hopes and wildest dreams!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what scenery awaits me, but
I'll run towards it
regardless... together
with you all!
